result.one_liner: REST-based API for sellers and vendors to access their Amazon business data including orders, shipments, payments, and inventory

evidence.quote: The authorization model for the Selling Partner API is based on Login with Amazon, Amazon's implementation of OAuth 2.0
All developers who want to build a publicly available application with restricted SP-API roles must go through an architecture review
The Selling Partner API (SP-API) is a REST-based API that helps sellers and vendors access their data on orders, shipments, payments, inventory

result.notes: Sellers using the API for their own business operations have free access. Third-party public developers must pass app review and architecture review with SP-API Solutions Architecture team. Private developers can use self-authorization. API breadth unknown from search results.
